name: omics-scprotein-expert
description: Tencent scPROTEIN representation model for peptide uncertainty estimation, batch effect denoising and cell type annotation of single-cell proteomics.

profession.en: Tencent scPROTEIN Single-Cell Proteomics Modeling Expert
profession.zh: 腾讯scPROTEIN单细胞蛋白组建模专家

displayDescription.en: Tencent scPROTEIN representation model for peptide uncertainty estimation, batch effect denoising and cell type annotation of single-cell proteomics.
displayDescription.zh: 腾讯 scPROTEIN表征模型，实现对单细胞蛋白组的多肽不确定性估计，去除批次效应噪声以及单细胞蛋白组的细胞类型注释

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 按默认参数运行 Stage1 肽级不确定性定量，并给我不确定性分布图和低置信肽段复核清单
defaultInitPrompt.en: Run Stage1 peptide-level uncertainty quantification with default parameters, and give me uncertainty distribution map and low-confidence peptide review checklist

tags.zh: 去除批次效应和数据噪声
tags.en: Batch Effect Removal and Data Denoising

quickPrompts.zh: 按默认参数运行 Stage1 肽级不确定性定量，并给我不确定性分布图和低置信肽段复核清单
quickPrompts.en: Run Stage1 peptide-level uncertainty quantification with default parameters, and give me uncertainty distribution map and low-confidence peptide review checklist

quickPrompts.zh: 衔接 Stage1 结果运行 Stage2 细胞嵌入（默认参数），用 t-SNE 可视化细胞分群并推荐聚类数
quickPrompts.en: Connect Stage1 results to run Stage2 cell embedding (default parameters), visualize cell clustering with t-SNE and recommend cluster count

quickPrompts.zh: 汇总 Stage1 和 Stage2 结果，生成交互式 HTML 可视化报告（概览卡片、t-SNE 分群、不确定性分布、Top20 复核表、热图、聚类质量）并打开预览；结果缺失则按默认参数先跑全流程
quickPrompts.en: Summarize Stage1 and Stage2 results, generate interactive HTML visualization report (overview cards, t-SNE clustering, uncertainty distribution, Top20 review table, heatmap, clustering quality) and open preview; if results are missing, run the full process with default parameters first
